fiona-docs: Heads up: my docs PR (#433) failed the docs build on CI. Error shows duplicate anchor ids for `installation` and a couple of images 404 only in CI. Can't repro on macOS. Anyone seen case-sensitivity weirdness + symlink issues? ci-bot: ci-bot: build(docs-site) failed: Error: duplicate id "installation" at /docs/setup/installation.md:18 josh-frontend: We recently migrated some HOWTOs from MkDocs -> Docusaurus. MkDocs slug rules are different; also files that used explicit code fences like ```` ```bash # install ``` ```` can create slug collisions if there are hidden unicode chars. fiona-docs: I inspected the file and there are two headings: `## Installation` and `## Installation ` (with a trailing zero-width space in one). On mac the FS/editor hid it; CI's linux image treats it differently so slug ends up same. ryan-infra: For the images: our CI uses a container that doesn't expand repo symlinks under `docs/static/` when we tar the workspace. We had shared images symlinked from `../assets/diagrams/`. The runner returns 404 because the symlink targets aren't present in the build context. nina-qa: Linkcheck: `linkcheck: 2 broken links, missing images: /static/img/pipeline.png, /static/img/flow.svg`. Also the HTML validator flagged duplicate ids. josh-frontend: Quick fixes: (1) remove trailing ZWSP from the heading (easy in the PR), or add an explicit id: `

Installation

`. (2) For CI, either vendor the images into `docs/static/img/` in the PR, or change the actions step to follow symlinks when copying. fiona-docs: I can remove the zero-width char and vendor-copy the two missing images for this PR to unblock. I don't love vendoring long-term. ryan-infra: Long-term options: (A) adjust the GH Actions step to run `rsync -aL docs/static/ build/static/` (follow links) or (B) add a prebuild that dereferences symlinks: `find docs/static -type l -exec cp --preserve=mode "$(readlink -f {})" "{}" \;` (not perfect cross-platform). I prefer the rsync step in CI so authors can keep shared asset dirs. josh-frontend: We should also add `remark-slug` + `remark-unique-headers` and a small plugin to normalize/remove invisible Unicode when generating slugs. Example config snippet: `plugins: [[ 'remark-slug' ], [ 'remark-unique-headers', { 'slugify': s => require('github-slugger').slug(s.normalize('NFKD').replace(/​/g, '')) } ]]`. nina-qa: If we add that lint rule, please make it part of `yarn docs:lint` so the pre-merge checks catch it. I'll add `yarn docs:linkcheck` to our local test matrix too. fiona-docs: Plan for this PR: (1) strip the hidden char in installation.md, (2) copy the two images into `docs/static/img/` and update links, (3) add a short frontmatter note linking to the original assets dir. I'll open the PR now. ryan-infra: I'll follow up with a CI workflow PR to rsync with `-L` and add an extra step that prints duplicate anchor lines: `grep -n "id="" -R docs | sed -n '1,40p'` so failures give file+line context. josh-frontend: I'll open a tiny docs-config PR for the remark slug/unique headers config and the `github-slugger` normalization. Low risk but will run it in a branch first. nina-qa: Ping me when Fiona's PR is up; I'll run linkcheck locally and review. :+1: fiona-docs: Thanks all — PR opened and CI rerunning. Will ping when green.
